subject: Availability: encryption, audit-logs & SSO evidence walkthrough
messages:
From: Sam Rivera <sam.rivera@hearthwell.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Hearthwell Security Team <security@hearthwell.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Requesting a technical walkthrough for SOC 2 evidence (KMS / audit logs / SSO)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the product overview last week — we made good progress. We'd like to schedule a focused technical walkthrough with your engineering/security team covering the items needed for our SOC 2 intake: key management and encryption controls, audit log retention/format, and SSO/SAML artifact flow.

Primary asks from Hearthwell:
- Inventory of evidence artifacts we should expect and where they live (artifact names + formats)
- A short KMS/key-rotation demo and how keys are scoped per-tenant
- Examples of audit logs (sample entries + retention policy)
- SSO flow diagram and assertion validation details

Our team is distributed between PST and EST; preferred windows are 10:00–13:00 PT on Oct 6–8 or 14:00–17:00 PT Oct 5. Can you confirm availability and who from Redwood will join?

Attaching a consolidated evidence checklist that we use for intake.

Thanks,
Sam Rivera
Head of Security Operations
Hearthwell Systems
Attachment: SOC2_request_template.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rivera <sam.rivera@hearthwell.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting a technical walkthrough for SOC 2 evidence (KMS / audit logs / SSO)

Hi Sam — great to hear and happy to run this.

We can cover the full list. Proposed attendees from Redwood:
- Jonas Weber (security liaison / product infra)
- Laura Bennett (solutions engineering — KMS & key scoping)
- Marissa Cole (customer success — evidence intake)
- Vivek Kulkarni (platform engineering — audit logs pipeline)

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Oct 6, 10:30–11:30 AM PT
- Wed Oct 7, 11:00–12:00 PM PT
- Thu Oct 8, 12:00–1:00 PM PT

If one of those works for you we'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda + sample artifacts in advance. Also, can you confirm if anyone on your side needs the call recorded or a pared-down demo without PII?

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@hearthwell.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Rivera <sam.rivera@hearthwell.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T12:08:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Requesting a technical walkthrough for SOC 2 evidence (KMS / audit logs / SSO)

Jonas — thanks. Wed Oct 7 at 11:00 AM PT works best for our engineers (that’s 2:00 PM ET). We do want the session recorded for internal review. PII should be redacted in any live demo — screenshots ok.

Two requests: can you add a short segment on how Redwood surfaces anomalous activity from audit logs, and can you provide exportable samples of log entries? Happy to share a short list of attendees once you confirm.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Security Engineer, Hearthwell

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Calendars / artifacts prep

Thanks — looping in CS to own evidence artifacts. I’ll draft the attendee list and agenda.

Agenda (draft):
1) 10m — Introductions & objectives
2) 20m — KMS design + tenant scoping + rotation demo (Laura)
3) 15m — Audit log schema, retention, and anomaly surfacing (Vivek)
4) 10m — SSO/SAML flow and assertion storage (Jonas)
5) 5m — Action items / evidence handoff (Marissa)

Marissa — can you prepare the SOC2_evidence_inventory.xlsx with the Redwood artifact names and expected formats? I’ll drop a Drive link and send the invite when you confirm.

Laura

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Calendars / artifacts prep

I’ve updated the inventory workbook (attached) to include expected filenames, sample formats, and short export commands where applicable. I also added a sample audit log CSV with 10 redacted rows and a small KMS diagram (PDF).

Files attached: SOC2_evidence_inventory.xlsx, redwood-kms-overview.pdf, audit-sample.csv

I’ll publish the Drive folder to the external share link and include it in the invite.

—Marissa
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sam Rivera <sam.rivera@hearthwell.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@hearthwell.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Wed Oct 7 11:00 AM PT — SOC 2 evidence walkthrough (recording allowed)

Thanks all — confirmed for Wed Oct 7, 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET.

Google Meet link: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij
Agenda: (final, attached in Drive) - Intros & goals - KMS scope & rotation demo (Laura) - Audit log schema, retention & anomaly surfacing (Vivek) - SSO assertion validation & evidence mapping (Jonas) - Next steps: evidence handoff and ticketing

Recording: agreed — we will record and redact any live PII.
Action items assigned:
- Marissa: publish Drive folder and upload final artifacts (SOC2_evidence_inventory.xlsx, sample logs) — due Oct 8
- Laura: short demo script and slides — due Oct 6 EOD
- Vivek: prepare sample log export and anomaly query examples — due Oct 6 EOD

Related: HubSpot deal HW-04219 updated with meeting outcome (link in calendar).

See you Wednesday,
Jonas
Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachment: timezone-availability.ics
